authority: p2.7a approval; finding F-CW17-INPUT-01; Root adjudication
required_behavior_root_adjudication: Separate automation safety from manual input. The dirty/uncertain line latch (InputBoundary.uncertain, needs_review) must keep blocking AUTOMATIC dispatch (submit/can_dispatch) and manager return (claim_manager) exactly as today (C-AC-26), but must NOT block manual input while the user owns host input.

Manual input target (C-AC-08 '수동 입력은 확인된 현재 대상에 전달'): while owner=='user', the current target is the PTY's observed foreground process group (e.g. tcgetpgrp on the slave / tpgid of the parent shell in /proc), provided it is a live process group in the parent shell's session. Deliver bytes (including ESC sequences, Backspace, Ctrl-C, Ctrl-D, Ctrl-Z, Ctrl-U) to the PTY for that target. The line discipline delivers signals; Workbench does not translate them.

If the foreground process group cannot be observed or is outside the shell session, keep holding manual input with a visible reason (C-AC-08 '현재 입력 대상도 불명' clause preserved). Automation-launched foreground run under confirmed takeover keeps its existing confirmed_target path.

Uncertainty must be recoverable: after a trustworthy shell control event (fresh prompt READY for the submitted line with the shell back at its prompt, or the shell-side wb-handoff CONTROL_READY verification with hook/jobs checks) the line-edit uncertainty resets, so a user who used editing keys can still return control via wb-handoff. Do not reset on timers or output heuristics (C-AC-26: no marker/prompt/no-output lifecycle inference) — only on the existing authenticated control-channel events.

ShellPane._accepts_manual_input in src/workbench/backend/panes.py must follow the adapter decision (no separate stricter phase=='unknown' block for manual input when the user owns input and the target is observable). Snapshot/state must still show uncertainty/unknown for automation.
acceptance_tests: tests/backend/test_live_input_independent.py must pass unmodified (it is the independent acceptance)

All previously passing suites must still pass: tests/terminal, tests/gates/g2_shell (non-live and canonical live matrix: tests.gates.g2_shell.test_canonical_matrix_integration), tests/backend (worker + independent), tests/contracts, tests/lifecycle, tests/gates/g4_lifetime non-live
allowed_write_paths: tests/gates/g2_shell/** (only to add regression cases; modifying an existing assertion requires listing it with justification in the result)
stop_conditions: an existing G2/CW-07 test encodes rejecting manual input to an observable user foreground target: do not delete it; list it with the conflicting spec clause and return needs_oracle if unsure
fix would require weakening automation holds, replay protection, or exact identity
